Initial release of go-skyvern, an unofficial typed Go client for the Skyvern API.

- Provides REST methods for managing tasks, agents, runs, browser sessions, profiles, credentials, scripts, schedules, tags, artifacts, and audit exports.
- Generated from the Skyvern OpenAPI specification using oapi-codegen.
- Requires Go toolchain and SKYVERN_API_KEY for authentication.
- Designed for use in Go projects needing Skyvern browser automation or already importing go-skyvern.
- Includes usage guide and security best practices in SKILL.md.
